meaning: Owner interpretation limit for an existing diagnostic, not unexpected benchmark failure or a request for new experiments/source changes.
observation: The method callback includes20s of explicit UPDATE t_hot SET v=v+1 WHERE id BETWEEN1AND20000 to build history, timedCOUNTs and15s recovery. The broad method-window business-write p99 therefore includes this churn as well as COUNT.
prohibitedInference: Do not attribute broad method-window writep99 increase solely to the COUNT query or solely to MVCC/history. The added bulk UPDATE can contend with ordinary workload writes. These are natural locks of simulated writes, not row-locking COUNT.
requiredDocumentationTreatment: Report per-COUNT timings as observations in the specified changing state, and label whole-window latency as combined churn+count+recovery diagnostic. No matched churn-without-count control means no isolated COUNT-latency causal estimate.
remediation: Documentation/interpretation only. Keep current nonlocking scope and data. Do not add new mandatoryexperiments or restart currentall.
